title_html:
The Go-First Software Engineering Ecosystem.
One Ecosystem. Every Workload.
lead_html: Krewire is an end-to-end digital SDLC platform and application ecosystem in Go — spanning the entire software lifecycle from specification, autonomous AI agents, enterprise SSO & RBAC, hybrid PaaS, virtual dev workspaces, to production server operations. Far beyond modular Go libraries, Krewire delivers a cohesive, unified platform driven by a single CLI krew. Built on three immutable pillars: secure, sustainable, and scalable.
meta: Go 1.27.1+ · Spec to Production · File-based routing · Scoped CSS · Progressive by design
